 Sea Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results, Approves New Buyback
 Tipranks - Tipranks - Wed Nov 11, 3:37PM CST 
 An update from Sea ( (SE) ) is now available.
 On November 10, 2026, Sea reported third-quarter revenue of $8.6 billion, up 43.4% year over year, gross profit of $3.9 billion and net income of $502.5 million; adjusted EBITDA rose 28.9% to $931.3 million. Shopee revenue rose 41.3% to $6.1 billion, Monee revenue rose 63.9% to $1.6 billion, and Garena revenue rose 28.6% to $840.1 million.
 Reported operating metrics included Shopee GMV of $39.7 billion, up 23.3% year over year; Monee loans outstanding of $12.6 billion, up 60.0%; and Garena bookings of $890.0 million, up 5.9%. After repurchasing 11.1 million shares for $997.2 million under its existing authorization, Sea said its board approved an additional $1.0 billion authorization on November 9, 2026.
